verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official SDK, client library, or language bindings for building against Terraform; the OpenAPI probe found nothing. The only nearby items are brief mentions that you can 'create a provider' or 'write your own' plugin, but neither names an SDK or describes one, so they don't establish the capability for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
